description: MANDATE-15 ca 'ban chu khong hong', ban cho EKS. Tao tai HOP LE that su bang cach nhan ban chinh load-generator cua he (khong co flag loi nao dinh vao) roi xac nhan detector KHONG keu oan. PASS = khong rule nao trong monitored_rule_ids ban trong cua so. Day la nua con lai cua cau hoi ma ca quiet-window khong tra loi duoc: quiet-window chi hoi 'binh thuong co keu nham khong', ca nay hoi 'BAN co bi nham la HONG khong'.
notes: BAN COMPOSE CU chay locust tu may ca nhan (`cd techx-corp-platform/src/load-generator && locust ...`). Khong dung tren EKS vi ba ly do: locust khong duoc ghim truc tiep ma keo theo locust-plugins[playwright] (tai ca trinh duyet ~hang tram MB); locustfile.py goi flagd OFREP luc khoi dong (locustfile.py:78) ma flagd tren EKS khong voi toi tu may ngoai; va no can LOCUST_HOST tro vao frontend co dia chi cong khai.

Thay bang nhan ban chinh deployment load-generator DANG CHAY SAN trong cum. No co 1 replica va KHONG co HPA (platform/charts/application/values.yaml — khong co block hpa cho load-generator), nen kubectl scale la an toan, khong danh nhau voi autoscaler. Moi pod chay LOCUST_USERS=10 nen 4 replica ~ 4x tai.

CHON nhan ban thay vi doi bien LOCUST_USERS: `kubectl set env` gay rollout, pod restart lam traffic tut mot nhip — ma nhip tut do co the tu no lam service-traffic-collapse keu, tao dung mot bao dong gia tren chinh ca dung de chung minh khong co bao dong gia.

KHONG day len qua ~50 user mot pod: resources.limits.memory cua load-generator la 500Mi, right-size cho 10 user HTTP thuan. OOMKill load-generator se lam oom-detected keu va lai tao bao dong gia. Nhan ban trai bo nho ra nhieu pod nen tranh duoc.

monitored_rule_ids liet ke DU 14 rule dang co trong rules.yaml (khong chi 3 nhu ban cu), gom ca service-traffic-collapse — rule nay dac biet dang theo doi vi tai tang roi tut ve muc cu la dung hinh dang ma no bat.
duration 420s de tai cao phu tron mot cua so rate(...[5m]) va con du bien; settle 180s de alert cham (neu co) van kip roi vao cua so cham diem.
